title: How acidic amino acid residues facilitate DNA target site selection.
authors: Hossain, Kazi Amirul; Kogut, Mateusz; Slabonska, Joanna; Sappati, Subrahmanyam; Wieczor, Milosz; Czub, Jacek
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文通过经典与从头算模拟解析转录因子中酸性残基Asp/Glu对DNA靶位点选择的分子机制，聚焦TF-DNA特异性结合与碱基读取，方法为物理模拟，高度契合本课题。
abstract: Despite the negative charge of the DNA backbone, acidic residues (Asp/Glu) commonly participate in the base readout, with a strong preference for cytosine. In fact, in the solved DNA/protein structures, cytosine is recognized almost exclusively by Asp/Glu through a direct hydrogen bond, while at the same time, adenine, regardless of its amino group, shows no propensity for Asp/Glu. Here, we analyzed the contribution of Asp/Glu to sequence-specific DNA binding using classical and ab initio simulations of selected transcription factors and found that it is governed by a fine balance between the repulsion from backbone phosphates and attractive interactions with cytosine. Specifically, Asp/Glu lower the affinity for noncytosine sites and thus act as negative selectors preventing off-target binding. At cytosine-containing sites, the favorable contribution does not merely rely on the formation of a single H-bond but usually requires the presence of positive potential generated by multiple cytosines, consistently with the observed excess of cytosine in the target sites. Finally, we show that the preference of Asp/Glu for cytosine over adenine is a result of the repulsion from the adenine imidazole ring and a tendency of purine-purine dinucleotides to adopt the BII conformation.
abstract_zh: 尽管DNA骨架带负电荷，酸性残基（Asp/Glu）通常参与碱基读取，并对胞嘧啶表现出强烈偏好。事实上，在已解析的DNA/蛋白质结构中，胞嘧啶几乎完全通过直接氢键被Asp/Glu识别，而同时，腺嘌呤无论其氨基基团如何，对Asp/Glu均无倾向性。在此，我们利用经典和从头算模拟对选定的转录因子进行分析，研究了Asp/Glu对序列特异性DNA结合的贡献，并发现该贡献受骨架磷酸基团排斥与胞嘧啶吸引相互作用之间精细平衡的调控。具体而言，Asp/Glu降低了对非胞嘧啶位点的亲和力，从而作为负选择因子防止脱靶结合。在含胞嘧啶的位点，有利贡献不仅依赖于单一氢键的形成，通常还需要多个胞嘧啶产生的正电位存在，这与靶位点中观察到的胞嘧啶过量一致。最后，我们表明Asp/Glu对胞嘧啶优于腺嘌呤的偏好是腺嘌呤咪唑环排斥作用以及嘌呤-嘌呤二核苷酸倾向采用BII构象的结果。
